chunks.title: Project: RootCite
chunks.text:
AI Copilot for Production Alerts
Tech stack: Python, FastAPI, Claude, pgvector, AWS CDK.
Code: https://github.com/sushantm47/rootcite
Live demo: https://sushantm47.github.io/rootcite/

chunks.title: Highlights: RootCite
chunks.text:
RootCite was previously named OpsPilot.
Built an AI copilot that diagnoses production alerts through a retrieve, investigate, synthesize, and verify loop on Claude, with tool calling, step and token budgets, and a citation for every claim.
Reached 1.000 hit@5 and MRR with hybrid BM25 and pgvector retrieval fused by reciprocal rank fusion, versus 0.909 for either alone, with an eval suite gating every merge in GitHub Actions.
Added prompt injection and PII guardrails and an MCP server, with Docker and AWS CDK infrastructure defined for ECS Fargate, RDS Postgres, and Secrets Manager.

chunks.title: Project: DealRadar
chunks.text:
Amazon Price Tracker
Tech stack: Python, Flask, MySQL, Chart.js.
Code: https://github.com/sushantm47/DealRadar

chunks.title: Highlights: DealRadar
chunks.text:
Built a full stack price tracker with a CloudScraper and BeautifulSoup scraper that handles deals, price ranges, and hidden prices, plus Chart.js price history charts in a Bootstrap dashboard.
Used MySQL triggers and stored procedures to flag price drops below user targets, and pulled deal news from RSS feeds.
